# @sharadox/globe-web-library

> Interactive 3D dot globe for React (three.js + @react-three/fiber), client-only.

- /globe: <Globe palette={{ ink, body, rim, dark }} home={{ latitude, longitude }} destinations={[...]} landPoints="/globe/land.bin" label className /> — fills positioned parent; load with next/dynamic ssr:false
- Generate land dots: `globe-land-points public/globe/land.bin` (bin) or landPoints(topology, samples=42000, southernLimit=-60)
- /drag-controller createDragController(initial, autoRotate) (pure); /globe-drag useGlobeDrag; /land-points useLandPoints(url)
- /world <World> scene for custom Canvas; /color globeColors(palette)
- CSS vars: --globe-glow, --globe-surface
- Peer: react, react-dom. License: Sharadox Open Source License 0.1.0
- Continuity on a soft navigation (web-library isSoftNavigation, e.g. a language switch): the new globe carries on from the previous rotation (controller.rotation()), starts exactly there (no swing-in), and land dots are cached per address
- /arc: Arc: a light arc between two places with a pulse along it
- /hex-channel: hexChannel("#rrggbb") → [red, green, blue] from 0 to 1, for shader colors
- /land-point-generator: landPoints(topology, options): evenly spaced dots on land (Fibonacci lattice), Antarctica left out below southernLimit
- /web-gl-support: supportsWebGl(): whether the browser can create a WebGL context
- /latitude-longitude-to-vector: latitudeLongitudeToVector(latitude, longitude, radius): a point on the sphere (longitude 0 faces the camera)
- /marker: Marker: a city dot lying flat on the surface
- /shader/arc: ARC_SHADER, and shader/dot, shader/atmosphere, shader/glow-vertex, shader/body: the globe's GLSL shaders
